rows.layout: lane i (0..255) <- HelperVectors[i].{s0, s1, s2, vcc} as v4..v7 (struct fields 0..3; scale/scaleVcc/fmas/fixup are the expected outputs, not inputs)

notes: Division.cpp has no Rows table: audit_modes.parse_rows cannot build rows for it. Each kernel is its own Shader with 32 lanes per dispatch; the C++ loops dispatch the table 32 vectors at a time (8 dispatches of 256 vectors). Lanes are independent, so one oracle run over all 256 rows (padded to whole waves) is equivalent.
Body: v_div_scale_f32 v10, s20, v4, v5, v6; v_cndmask v11 <- s20; v_cmp_ne_u32 vcc, 0, v7 (per-lane VCC from the vcc field); v_div_fmas_f32 v12; v_div_fixup_f32 v13.
Asserted columns: 0 and 1 only for vectors with s0 == s1 or s0 == s2 (210 of 256); column 2 only when the host fuses FMA (HostFusesFma via FmaCode) — always comparable on the oracle; column 3 always.
verified: disassembly (llvm-mc gfx1030) of words 10..18; CheckHelpers() read; rows file extracted from the C array (256 x 8 fields, first 4 kept)
